stories.text: Thomas Markle, 82, father of Meghan, appears in court over child sex abuse material after his arrest in Florida following an FBI search.
President Trump names Stephen Miller as his new chief of staff, a choice likely to set up clashes with Congress.
A mayor in Texas tells police to limit cooperation with ICE, informing the agency only about people arrested for jailable offences.
Brand's barrister Ian Winter refers himself to the regulator after reportedly confronting a reporter who had investigated the comedian.
The UK has a plan for a Black Sky event, which could cut power, water and communications to millions of people.
Married at First Sight UK has been cancelled after a BBC Panorama investigation, and cast members react with relief, tears and sadness.
Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall answers his England omission with a superb goal as Everton come from behind to beat Coventry City 3-1.
A Gladiator II stuntman, Edward Sarsfield, sues over severe burns he says he suffered in an explosion while filming on a burning ship.
Dover MP Mike Tapp says a launch from the Netherlands shows people smugglers are adapting and will find new methods and locations.
Paraguay's president Santiago Pena is impeached and removed after a bank collapse left millions of people unable to reach their money.
